text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) secondary to natalizumab therapy. Given your history of Crohn's disease treated with natalizumab and the new onset of unilateral ataxia, you are at high risk for PML. The MRI brain images you requested previously likely showed non-enhancing white matter lesions, and the CSF tests for JC virus DNA would be confirmatory. Immediate cessation of natalizumab and specialist neurology management are required.
